asset.title: Live Create Export Reload
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser benchmark proof clip. Judge only visible product behavior: fresh-room flow, uploads, public NodeAgent invocation, streaming/tool traces, focus/attention UI, artifact creation/download, and production honesty. Clip duration, silence, or README pacing is not a product defect.

judge.summary: The video successfully demonstrates the creation of a NodeRoom, navigation between sheets, exporting data to XLSX, and reloading the room while maintaining state and chat history.

featureClarity.evidence: The user clearly navigates from room creation to sheet viewing, triggers an export, and performs a page reload.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the complete lifecycle: creation, data viewing, action (export), and persistence verification via reload.

visualDesign.evidence: High-density dark UI with clear active states, though the initial skeleton loader is quite prominent.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the NodeRoom paradigm of sheets, sidebars, and agent chat panels.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Captured from a live browser session showing real-time UI rendering and state recovery.

legibility.evidence: All text, sheet cells, and chat messages are highly legible at standard resolution.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Demonstrates robust state persistence and export capabilities critical for professional workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Shows the actual loading delays and skeleton screens without artificial cuts.

observedEvidence: Sheet tab switching (Company research to Q3 variance)

defects.observed: Initial room creation skeleton state persists for 10 seconds, which feels slightly sluggish.
defects.fix: Optimize cold-start room provisioning or add a more engaging progress indicator.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeRoom spin up a fresh session, navigate complex financial sheets, export to XLSX, and seamlessly recover state after a full browser reload.
